Berlin Friedrichstraße Utopia 2048

A bird’s-eye matte painting of central Berlin in 2048: terraced green hills over the railway, solar roofs, canals for swimming and solar boats, and an airship in a clear sky.

Source
Realutopien: Berlin Friedrichstraße Utopia 2048
Creator
Aerroscape and Lino Zeddies
Made
2023
Style

Moods
Hopeful, sunlit, verdant, panoramic

Context

Realutopien, a project of Reinventing Society e. V., publishes the image as “Berlin Friedrichstraße Utopia 2048 by Lino Zeddies & Aerroscape, CC BY-SA 4.0”, with other “Utopia 2048” views by Aerroscape (Singapore, Landleben, Vehlefanz). Realutopien.

The Commons upload is dated 6 May 2023 and describes “a futuristic, sustainable Berlin - with lots of solar power, trees and greenery, airships, walkable streets, clean water”. A Commons reviewer confirmed the license on 7 October 2023. Commons file page.

Observed

  • The view looks east over Bahnhof Friedrichstraße, whose arched train shed carries blue solar panels. The Fernsehturm stands on the horizon.
  • A hill of stepped, planted terraces with buildings rises behind the station. Two towers in the distance are wrapped in trees.
  • At right, a tall slab is clad in solar panels and planting and carries two vertical-axis wind turbines on its roof.
  • The Spree runs through the foreground with swimmers, a small solar boat, and steps down to the water. Streets are full of pedestrians, cyclists, and market stalls, with no cars visible.
  • Arched pedestrian bridges, a monorail-like train, an airship marked “art by aerroscape”, and a hot-air balloon fill the scene.
  • The palette is saturated leaf green and clear sky blue, with cream and terracotta buildings. The rendering is a detailed, semi-realistic digital painting, not outlined.

Why it belongs

The painting shows the architectural branch of solarpunk: an existing city retrofitted, not replaced. Historic buildings stay, and green and solar layers grow over them.

Its realistic matte-painting finish differs from the outlined, flat illustration in the style’s core, but its colour and content match the grammar closely.

Borrow

Use a high, wide viewpoint over a recognizable place to show change at city scale.

Keep the existing landmarks and add planting, solar roofs, and water access around them.
